children: shares climbed 4% Wednesday as investors focused on Goldman Sachs' higher projections for the AI server market and Dell's position in data-center infrastructure.

Goldman expects AI-related infrastructure spending to remain a major driver of server demand. Its research has estimated global AI investment at about $1 trillion in 2026, including roughly $581 billion in the U.S.

Dell has been expanding its exposure to that market. Its Infrastructure Solutions Group reported strong recent growth, while the company's latest results showed a $95 billion AI server backlog and $60.9 billion of AI server orders.

The stock's latest move also comes as investors weigh concerns over a potential slowdown in AI development. AI-linked shares came under pressure earlier this week after industry executives called for a slower pace of development, although spending commitments from major technology companies remain substantial.
Goldman's latest market outlook adds to the focus on whether continued data-center investment can support Dell's growth as AI infrastructure demand evolves.

title: Goldman's AI Server Forecast Sends Dell Stock Jumping
